name: ms-grouped-induced_marginal-4gpu-s44-20261022-v2
description: Seed replication s44, grouped multi-select gold targets, objective=induced_marginal, 4xH100 (v2: prune old best checkpoints; disk quota fix)
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
M=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B
D=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi
OUT=$R/runs/qz/grouped_induced_marginal_4gpu_s44/v1
LOG=$R/logs/qz/grouped_induced_marginal_4gpu_s44.log
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$OUT"
cd "$R"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
"$V/bin/python" -I "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" --validate-only \
  --train "$D/train.jsonl" --dev "$D/dev.jsonl" \
  --model "$M" --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --target gold --objective set --set-loss induced_marginal --count-weight 1 --world-size 4 --global-batch 64 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --validate-output "$R/logs/qz/grouped_induced_marginal_4gpu_s44_validate.json" \
  > "$R/logs/qz/grouped_induced_marginal_4gpu_s44_validate.log" 2>&1 || { echo "validation failed"; tail -60 "$R/logs/qz/grouped_induced_marginal_4gpu_s44_validate.log"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/torchrun" --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc_per_node 4 \
  "$R/harness/train_multiselect.py" \
  --train "$D/train.jsonl" --dev "$D/dev.jsonl" \
  --model "$M" --modules "$R/innerjev/configs/4B/modules.json" \
  --target gold --objective set --set-loss induced_marginal --count-weight 1 --output "$OUT" \
  --lr 2e-6 --global-batch 64 --epochs 1 \
  --max-input-tokens 8192 --max-batch-tokens 8192 \
  --eval-every-frac 0.1 --lambda-g 0 --graph none --seed 44 --expect-trainable 3313500160 \
  > "$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
